parsed.missing_from_rule: The rule omits that the in-person visit must be with the treating practitioner, must include evaluation of diabetes control, and must include determination that criteria (1-4) are met.
parsed.explanation: The rule only checks for an in-person visit within 6 months, but the policy requires that the visit is with the treating practitioner, includes evaluation of diabetes control, and determination that criteria (1-4) are met. These are substantive requirements that could affect claim outcomes.
